title: How big can sprite s really be?

posts.author: Juzkhain
posts.body:
Hi everyone.
I've been flirting with RPG Maker for a lot of years and I've never really done anything with it. One of my biggest problems have allways been the same:the sprites.
See, I don't really like pixel art sprites, I don't find them eye apealing, I mean, there are games with amazing pixel art, but I can't make amazing pixel art. -
What I mean is that i don't like the pixel art that i can produce, when I see it in games i love it, but when I do it I'm never happy with the results, just for clarification.
I'm good at drawing but not at drawing pixel art.
So recently I've find myself with the itch of making something in RPG Maker again, and I've think to my self: "
maybe i could draw the sprites?
"
The thing is that drawn sprites would be very big. I know that you can make the sprites bigger and that you can resize the collision boxes, but how big could the sprites be?
Could you make for example 100x50 sprites? Would you be able to work in the editor confortably with this sizes? Could you make background tiles with that kind of sizes?
Also, what Game Maker would you recomend for game with 100% custom sprites and tiles? I remember trying to implement custom sprites in RPG Maker MV and having some troubles.
Any other advice?
Thank you so much.

posts.author: SGHarlekin
posts.body:
That's not even that big tbh. Can easily be done in MV too. YOu'll need a plugin to fix some clipping issueus, RM has with big sprites, but that's true for both MV and MZ, and both have free ones available.
Other than that I don't see a problem. You'll have to conform to the 48 x 48 tile size (or smaller in the case of MZ) or go the parallax route instead, but overall completely possible without much hassle tbh.
(Also "Don't like pixel art." *Has pixel art profile pic* is hilarious.)

That's...not very big. And it would be weirdly proportioned, basically the same height as a normal character sprite but twice as fat.

Click to expand...
You don't really work in the editor with character sprites. You select them in a few different screens, and that's it.
Juzkhain said:
Could you make background tiles with that kind of sizes?
Click to expand...
SGHarlekin said:
You'll have to conform to the 48 x 48 tile size
Click to expand...
Actually, Shaz has a tile size plugin that allows you to use tiles of whatever dimensions you like.
Or you could go the parallax mapping route, but Shaz's plugin would work if you're using a consistent tile size.
Juzkhain said:
Also, what Game Maker would you recomend for game with 100% custom sprites and tiles? I remember trying to implement custom sprites in RPG Maker MV and having some troubles.
Click to expand...
...any of them? It's impossible to say without knowing what "some troubles" means, but tons of people use completely custom art in MV and have no problem at all.
All of the expected asset standards are right in the help file.

posts.author: Iron_Brew
posts.body: My battlers are bloody massive - 307x307 cells. There's presumably an upper limit, but I've never hit it!

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
There's an upper limit based on the size of the image file in RAM - people have tried to load huge iconsets and parallax maps that are just black in-game because the file can't load.
I don't think you'll hit that limit with characters/battlers that are small enough to fit in the game window.

posts.author: bgillisp
posts.body:
There's a practical upper limit for sprites on map too where it will just look bad and perform badly. I tried once to put a sprite that was something like 480 x 480 pixels and animate it and it flickered badly going between frames.
But that was also in ACE. It may work better in other engines.
